name: Omaxe Limited
tagline: Delhi-NCR-rooted real estate/construction developer (residential, commercial, retail across 31 cities) now in deep financial distress - negative shareholder equity, a Rs 166.61 Cr consolidated net loss in Q3 FY26 alone, a five-year revenue CAGR of -12.94%, and Rs 2,723 Cr of contingent liabilities. Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@RupakRoyC, bullish, medium conviction).
business_overview: Omaxe Ltd (NSE/BSE: OMAXE) develops residential, commercial and retail real estate projects across 31 cities in 8 Indian states, historically strongest in Delhi-NCR (Faridabad, New Chandigarh) with a mix of townships, malls and hospitality assets. The company has been in a multi-year execution and balance-sheet crisis: persistent operating losses, stalled/delayed projects, and reliance on related-party/AIF NCD funding (e.g. a Rs 19 Cr NCD issue by a subsidiary to an AIF) to stay afloat.

fundamentals_narrative: Omaxe combines negative shareholder equity with ongoing large quarterly losses (Rs 166.61 Cr in Q3 FY26 alone) and a five-year revenue CAGR of -12.94% - a business that is shrinking and burning capital simultaneously, not merely cyclically weak. Rs 2,723 Cr of contingent liabilities sit alongside the negative net worth, and ~15% of promoter holding remains pledged even after one promoter family member's FY26 no-fresh-pledge disclosure. This is a going-concern-risk profile, not a turnaround-in-progress story on the evidence found.
